ThreeDCamera

Source: R/camera_3d.R
ThreeDCameraClass.Rd

A camera looking at the scene from spherical angles phi (polar, off the z axis) and theta (azimuth), rotated by gamma about its line of sight, with a perspective projection of strength focal_distance and a zoom factor. Mobjects with shade_in_3d = TRUE are sorted by depth and shaded by their normal against light_source. The angles live in ValueTracker()s (phi_tracker, theta_tracker, gamma_tracker, focal_distance_tracker, zoom_tracker) so they can be animated.

get_frame_center() is the 3D point shown at the center of the screen. Upstream manim subtracts the frame center twice (once in the projection and once in the 2D view); here it is subtracted once, so a point at the frame center lands at the screen center and fixed in frame mobjects really stay fixed.

Usage

ThreeDCamera(
  focal_distance = 20,
  shading_factor = 0.2,
  default_distance = 5,
  light_source_start_point = 9 * DOWN + 7 * LEFT + 10 * OUT,
  should_apply_shading = TRUE,
  exponential_projection = FALSE,
  phi = 0,
  theta = -90 * DEGREES,
  gamma = 0,
  zoom = 1,
  frame_center = ORIGIN,
  ...
)

Arguments

focal_distance

Distance from the camera to the frame center; smaller values give a stronger perspective.

shading_factor, default_distance

Kept for compatibility with Manim.

light_source_start_point

Initial position of the light source.

should_apply_shading

Shade mobjects that have shade_in_3d = TRUE.

exponential_projection

Scale points in front of the frame by an exponential rather than the usual perspective factor.

phi, theta, gamma

Polar angle, azimuth and roll of the camera, in radians.

zoom

Zoom factor.

frame_center

3D point shown at the center of the screen.

...

Passed to CameraClass.

Value

A camera: an R6 object of the class named by the function called. The objects whose names end in Class are the R6 class generators that these functions call.

Details

Shaded strokes are drawn in the mean of their two shaded colors rather than as a gradient, which grid can only do through a costly mask.
